spaces: configured AP/UI policy enum (1/2/3, plus hidden 0)
AT*BAND NwMode argument space sent to the modem (0/1/5/11, default 99)
AT*BAND NwMode response space recognised by the parser (0/4/5/8/11/15), mapped back into the policy space
CI preferred-mode readback space (0/1/2/3/0x3081) consumed by the temporary normalizer
numeric_spaces.warning: These four spaces must not be collapsed. In particular the AT*BAND NwMode space and the CI preferred-mode readback space are different: 0x3081 belongs only to the latter.

preferred_network_record_75.round_trip: Policy values 0, 2 and 3 round-trip through AT*BAND (sent 0/5/11, parsed back to 0/2/3). Policy value 1 sends NwMode 1, which the response parser does not recognise and maps to -1. The set and get value sets overlap but are not identical.

value_0x3081.role: compared for equality against the raw CI preferred-mode readback at mobile VA 0x4a2f0; normalizes to policy value 3, the same result as raw 0 and as the default branch
value_0x3081.cp_presence: NEGATIVE EVIDENCE: absent from 05-ARBI.bin as an ARM or Thumb-2 movw immediate and as a literal word
value_0x3081.bit_structure: unknown; the value is only ever equality-compared, never masked or shifted, and no CP constant corroborates a bitfield reading
value_0x3081.retracted: It is not an AT*BAND network-mode argument. The NwMode values actually sent are 0, 1, 5 and 11.

preferred_network_record_75.warning: The configured RPC/UI enum and the modem-facing enums are different numeric spaces. 0x3081 is confirmed only as a distinguished readback value that normalizes to LTE-preferred; calling it a RAT mask is not supported.

network_selection_status_record_84.daemon_writer: single setter at mobile ELF VA 0x425ec (record write 0x42618, temporary commit 0x42658), which also stages the value at status-object +0x2bc
network_selection_status_record_84.callsite_note: Fifteen call sites were enumerated. Values 1, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are not written with an immediate at any site; two sites pass a computed register, which is where those values are expected to originate.
network_selection_status_record_84.gate_linkage: Values 1 (registering), 3 (searching) and 11 (canceling) are exactly the three states that block SetPrefNetType and SetNetSel in libmobile, each with its own refusal message. Value 13 names the SMS interaction directly, which is why those setters also read record 19.
